content_sections.heading: About Jadavpur University Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Jadavpur University is a university in Kolkata (Kolkata – 700 032). The notice is issued jointly by the Registrar, Jadavpur University, and the Head, Department of International Relations, and both signatures are dated 25 November 2026. The Guest Faculty posts are in the university's Department of International Relations, and the areas of specialization are open.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice gives 2 vacancies in total, both in one department. It does not give a category-wise break-up. Areas of Specialization: Open.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The minimum qualifications printed in the notice are: BA (Hons) in Political Science/IR; MA in Political Science/IR; NET/SET in Political Science/IR. Preference will be given to candidates having a PhD degree in Political Science/IR with evidence of research publications and teaching experience. A PhD is a preference, not part of the minimum qualifications. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for the post.

rows.qualification: Essential Qualifications: As per UGC / State Government norms. Minimum qualifications are listed below.
rows.experience: Teaching experience is a preference (see below).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Rs. 500/ per class. The pay is per class taken. The notice does not mention a monthly amount or any allowance. Tenure: One Year. Nature of appointment: Guest Faculty in the Department of International Relations, Jadavpur University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Jadavpur University Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Applying has two steps. First, send your CV by email by the deadline. Then attend the walk-in interview in person. Send your CV by email to [email protected] by Tuesday December 8, 2026. On Thursday December 10, 2026, report at 10:15 AM at the Office of the Head of the Department of International Relations, Jadavpur University. Bring the documents listed below to the venue. Attend the walk-in interview, which starts at 10:45 AM.

faq.answer: Jadavpur University has announced 2 [Two] Guest Faculty vacancies in the Department of International Relations.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for Jadavpur University Guest Faculty in International Relations?
faq.answer: The essential qualifications are as per UGC / State Government norms. The minimum qualifications are BA (Hons) in Political Science/IR, MA in Political Science/IR and NET/SET in Political Science/IR.
